title: Favorite Products API
subtitle: RESTful Microservice with Clean Architecture & SOLID
summary: High-performance RESTful API designed with Clean Architecture, SOLID principles, and automated testing for managing favorite product lists.
overview: Decoupled microservice built with Node.js and TypeScript adhering to Clean Architecture and SOLID principles to provide a resilient API for managing favorite products.
responsibilities: Domain-driven design isolating business logic from infrastructure frameworks.
Dependency Inversion Principle (DIP) and repository pattern implementation.
Comprehensive suite of unit and integration tests with Jest.

challengesAndSolutions.challenge: Ensuring maximum maintainability and complete database decoupling.
challengesAndSolutions.solution: Utilized repository interfaces and native dependency injection.

metrics: 100% test coverage of core business domain rules with Jest
Zero tight coupling to database persistence layer

owaspMitigations.title: Broken Access Control (IDOR)
owaspMitigations.description: IDOR (Insecure Direct Object Reference) mitigation via strict resource ownership validation and tests asserting HTTP 403 Forbidden.

owaspMitigations.title: Security Misconfiguration
owaspMitigations.description: Custom global exception handler wrapping third-party failures in semantic HTTP 503 responses, preventing internal stack trace leaks.

owaspMitigations.title: Identification & Auth Failures
owaspMitigations.description: RESTful API endpoints secured via lightweight token-based authentication (Laravel Sanctum).
